agents.name: CoordinatorAgent
agents.role: Orchestrates the pipeline, assembles final output
agents.note: No LLM used. Deterministic orchestration only.

agents.name: OrderSellerAgent
agents.role: Retrieves order status, items, seller handoff timing from CSV
agents.note: Pandas DataFrame lookup + datetime comparison. No LLM.

agents.name: PaymentAgent
agents.role: Retrieves payment rows, computes totals, detects split payments
agents.note: Arithmetic aggregation on CSV data. No LLM.

agents.name: DeliveryAgent
agents.role: Compares delivery dates, determines if delivery was late

agents.name: PolicyAgent
agents.role: Applies EC_POLICY_V1 business rules, determines primary_issue and refund
agents.note: 6-rule deterministic priority chain. No LLM. All agents < 10B constraint satisfied.

agents.name: VerifierAgent
agents.role: Validates output schema, evidence IDs, array limits, and financials

compliance.approach: All business rules are fully deterministic from CSV data. No generative model is needed or used. Each agent is 0B (rule-based) which is strictly less than 10B.
